$comment: Each source is one slice of an API OpenAPI document served at {api}/openapi/{document}.json. `include` keeps only paths with one of these prefixes, `exclude` drops paths under its prefixes again; everything not reachable from the kept paths is dropped. The platform slice leaves out site, domain and business-launch management, private app creation and the consent wording catalog: those are Dashboard operations the SDK does not wrap. The `v1` document carries the resident, customer-auth, storefront and customer operations side by side, so those four slices are cut from the same download.
